changelog: **`application.stage_changed` on the event bus (#1998, 3/n):** a new public catalogue event `{ applicationId, requisitionId, from, to }` raised for every move of `Application.stage`. `moveApplicationStage()` (the one writer) notes the move; `stageTransaction()` (`src/lib/applicationStageEvents.ts`) replaces `prisma.$transaction` at all eight callers and raises the noted events only after the commit, so a rolled-back move (a lost panel-outcome seal, a bulk conflict) announces nothing. A move noted outside `stageTransaction()` throws outside production. No note and no disposition code on the bus.

en: Webhooks can now subscribe to application stage changes — shortlisted, interview, offer, hired, rejected or withdrawn.
tr: Webhook'lar artık başvuru aşaması değişikliklerine abone olabiliyor — kısa liste, mülakat, teklif, işe alındı, reddedildi veya geri çekildi.
de: Webhooks können jetzt Statuswechsel von Bewerbungen abonnieren — Shortlist, Interview, Angebot, eingestellt, abgelehnt oder zurückgezogen.
